controls: AES-256-GCM secrets bound to canonical user and pending/active purpose.
Own password reauthentication for setup/disable; a pending setup is not MFA.
Strict six-digit TOTP, bounded time window, single-use counters and persisted failure locks.
No database/demo fallback in production; key and audit failures deny success.
Factor revisions fence old sessions; refresh cannot fabricate a new MFA time.
Application and role policies enforce independent MFA; PIM requires actual fresh factor evidence.
Recovery codes are hashed and consumed once; recovery issues no normal session and invalidates the old factor/sessions.
limits: The production service currently has zero enrolled OpenDirectory factors and zero recovery codes. Code integration does not mean the personal production factor is configured.
The user must complete setup in their own authenticator and save recovery codes privately; no production factor or login token was manufactured for this check.
No SMS, push or WebAuthn/passkey support is claimed.
Personal production sign-in remains unverified; no existing production browser is available.
